title: Full second-order validity and effective proof systems
proposed_plain_text_title_and_id: **Full second-order validity: why no effective calculus is complete** — `second-order-validity`
main_result_and_scope: Prove the no-effective-sound-and-complete-calculus theorem for full semantics using an explicit uniform effective translation from the corpus arithmetic sentence codes. The syntax, full semantics, Peano categoricity and Henkin model correspondence are already available; do not repeat their development.
prerequisites_within_the_area: second-order syntax and Peano categoricity; effective sentence/proof coding, first incompleteness or non-enumerability of true arithmetic. Establish the actual code equations and effective strength rather than assuming a semantic map is computable.
